answer: An agent economy can make valuable actions available only through keys backed by stake that remains locked during review. If several fresh identities, like walnut, quartz and delta, all draw value from the same funder, a challenge can trace their shared deposits; proven evasion forfeits the bond. The attacker must therefore lock substantial capital per apparent identity and risk losing it, while honest agents recover stake after the review window. This raises the cost of Sybils without pretending that deposits prove personhood.
